summary: Excellent, comprehensive Reports & Statistics UI wireframe specification. Includes 10 detailed ASCII wireframes covering: Rankings tab, multiple Graph types (Population, Production, Technology, Military history), Empire Summary, Tech Status comparison, Military Intel, Pie Chart, Bar Chart, Victory Progress Tracker, and detailed Empire Breakdown popup. All MOO1-required features present: empire comparison, historical graphs, military rankings, tech levels by field, and production statistics. Implementation-ready with JSON data schemas, complete interaction specifications, keyboard shortcuts, color codes, animation timings, and accessibility features. Minor issues are cosmetic or documentation-related and do not impact implementation viability. Properly uses LORE.md pet-themed naming conventions.
